locations.title: Chumly the Rocket Man
locations.description: **Solution:** ||Stand still and let Chumly move above you, then move out of the way before he drops down. When he's on the floor, slam the ground next to him. Repeat this three times.||

locations.title: Itsy the Ice Demon
locations.description:
**Solution:** ||Let Itsy get close enough and then avoid his attack. While he's dazed after his attack, jump and tail swipe his head.

Each time he's hit, he will split into smaller and smaller versions. Repeat the tactic until only the smallest versions are left which will roll toward you. Time a jump and smash attack to defeat them.||
